commit 3e1ca788a927438147c862f1ffa34f2bc51ccfea
Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Sat May 17 10:12:02 2025 +0300
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Sat May 17 10:12:02 2025 +0300

    Bug 783526 - remove never set NS_MSG_CUSTOM_HEADERS_OVERFLOW. r=edicharry
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D249749

diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/filter.properties b/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/filter.properties
index 3152ca5afdc..27d1c8e28af 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/filter.properties
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/chrome/messenger/filter.properties
@@ -14,7 +14,6 @@ deleteFilterConfirmation=Are you sure you want to delete the selected filter(s)?
 matchAllFilterName=Match All Messages
 filterListBackUpMsg=Your filters do not work because the msgFilterRules.dat file, which contains your filters, could not be read. A new msgFilterRules.dat file will be created and a backup of the old file, called rulesbackup.dat, will be created in the same directory.
 customHeaderOverflow=You've exceeded the limit of 50 custom headers. Please remove one or more custom headers and try again.
-filterCustomHeaderOverflow=Your filters have exceeded the limit of 50 custom headers. Please edit the msgFilterRules.dat file, which contains your filters, to use fewer custom headers.
 invalidCustomHeader=One of your filters uses a custom header that contains an invalid character, such as ':', a non-printable character, a non-ascii character, or an eight-bit ascii character. Please edit the msgFilterRules.dat file, which contains your filters, to remove invalid characters from your custom headers.
 continueFilterExecution=Applying filter %S failed. Would you like to continue applying filters?
 promptTitle=Running Filters
diff --git a/mailnews/base/public/msgCore.h b/mailnews/base/public/msgCore.h
index 7ccd8ced741..f58e0bcc881 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/public/msgCore.h
+++ b/mailnews/base/public/msgCore.h
@@ -148,9 +148,6 @@ class nsIMsgFolder;
 // so the listeners can know that we didn't run the url.
 #define NS_MSG_ERROR_URL_ABORTED NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(27)
 
-// when num of custom headers exceeds 50
-#define NS_MSG_CUSTOM_HEADERS_OVERFLOW NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(28)
-
 // when custom header has invalid characters (as per rfc 2822)
 #define NS_MSG_INVALID_CUSTOM_HEADER NS_MSG_GENERATE_FAILURE(29)
 
diff --git a/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgFilterService.cpp b/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgFilterService.cpp
index e4ced5effc1..6c5b1a2f445 100644
--- a/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgFilterService.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgFilterService.cpp
@@ -177,8 +177,7 @@ NS_IMETHODIMP nsMsgFilterService::OpenFilterList(
       NS_ENSURE_SUCCESS(rv, rv);
       return OpenFilterList(aFilterFile, rootFolder, aMsgWindow,
                             resultFilterList);
-    } else if (rv == NS_MSG_CUSTOM_HEADERS_OVERFLOW && aMsgWindow)
-      ThrowAlertMsg("filterCustomHeaderOverflow", aMsgWindow);
+    }
     else if (rv == NS_MSG_INVALID_CUSTOM_HEADER && aMsgWindow)
       ThrowAlertMsg("invalidCustomHeader", aMsgWindow);
   }
title: Bug 783526 - remove never set NS_MSG_CUSTOM_HEADERS_OVERFLOW. r=edicharry
